info.title: Magpie API
info.description: The API of Magpie's window, served by `magpie web` for programs that run and drive it. Send the web key (MAGPIE_WEB_KEY) as a bearer token. Magpie's own page authenticates with a cookie instead. `magpie web` is on a machine its caller may not be at, so it performs no desktop actions: the caller opens URLs, copies text and shows files itself. With MAGPIE_AGENTS_FILE (Cypheria integration mode) the agents, sessions and subscriptions are only those of the agents in that file, and plugins are off; see the README.

tags.name: Host
tags.description: Desktop-host conveniences. `magpie web` does not perform them; the calling application owns these actions.

post.description: The returned status contains the URL when available. `magpie web` does not open a browser; poll GET /api/signin/{id} while the state is `waiting` and let the calling application open the URL. A sign-in whose CLI is not installed fails at once: Cypheria builds never install agent CLIs. In Cypheria integration mode only the subscriptions of the agents in the agents file (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Devin, Gemini, Antigravity, Grok) can be signed in to; any other is refused with 400.

bearerAuth.description: The `magpie web` key: the exact MAGPIE_WEB_KEY value, or the key in the link a run prints when none is set.

HostUnavailable.description: Desktop integration is unavailable in `magpie web`

sessionTerminal.description: SessionTerminal is the Mac app that opens a resumed session, by bundle id.

currency.description: Currency is what a cost — the Usage page's, the tray panel's, the TUI's and the CLI's — is shown converted to.

dockWindow.description: DockWindow shows it in the Dock only while its window is open, so Cmd-Tab reaches the window without an icon kept there the rest of the time.

lan.description: LAN shares the gateway on the local network, for agents on other machines.

codexWarmup.description: CodexWarmup starts a ChatGPT account's next window as soon as the last one resets, with one tiny request, so it counts from then (a Codex window starts at its first use)

claudeWarmup.description: ClaudeWarmup is CodexWarmup for the Claude accounts, the request sent through Claude Code.

codexWarmAt.description: CodexWarmAt starts each ChatGPT account's 5-hour window at a time of day of the user's choosing, local "15:04", with the same tiny request.

codexAutoReset.description: CodexAutoReset are the ChatGPT accounts (lower-case) that spend one of their rate-limit resets by themselves once their weekly window is used up and no other account can take the request.

workbuddyCheckin.description: WorkBuddyCheckin presses WorkBuddy's daily check-in (签到) for each signed-in WorkBuddy (China) account once a Beijing day, claiming the credits it gives while its event runs.

noStats.description: Stops the daily event that counts magpie's users. Usage statistics are always off in this build.

noUpdatePill.description: NoUpdatePill keeps the header's Update pill away when a newer magpie is out.

vision.description: Vision is the model that describes an image to a model that can't see it.

imageGen.description: ImageGen is the model magpie's generate_image tool draws with (the gateway's /v1/images/generations when a request names no model)

trayUsages.description: TrayUsages are the subscriptions and plans whose windows are shown beside the tray icon, in the order shown, each by its provider and account ("claude|a@b.c")

trayUsage.description: TrayUsage is TrayUsages' first, all a magpie before them read.

trayUsageEvery.description: TrayUsageEvery is how often, in minutes, that text is brought up to date.

trayNoLogos.description: TrayNoLogos draws the Mac menu bar's cards without their logos.

quotaLeft.description: QuotaLeft shows a subscription's windows by how much of each is left, not used.

usageAlert.description: UsageAlert is how much of a subscription's or plan's window, in percent, is used when magpie says so with a notification.

balanceAlert.description: BalanceAlert is the balance a key or account has fallen to when magpie says so, in that balance's own currency or credits, once until it is topped up past it again.

textSize.description: TextSize is how large the window's and the tray panel's pages are drawn, in percent (one of TextSizes)

hiddenModels.description: HiddenModels are the catalog entries (their ids, "<provider>/<model>" or a group's) taken out of an agent's lists one by one, by agent id, after Visible.

modelNames.description: The names the user gave models, by "<provider id>/<model id>".

modelEfforts.description: ModelEfforts are the reasoning levels the user keeps of a model's, by "<provider id>/<model id>".

modelImages.description: ModelImages is whether the user said a model takes images, by "<provider id>/<model id>".

modelPrices.description: ModelPrices is what a model costs the user, in USD per million tokens, by "<provider id>/<model id>", and "*" for every model of that provider.

modelOutputs.description: ModelOutputs is the most a reply of a model may hold, by "<provider id>/<model id>", and "*" for every model of that provider.

modelWires.description: ModelWires is the name to send a vendor for a model magpie knows by another, by "<provider id>/<model id>", and "*" for every model of that provider.

terminalApps.description: Mac apps that explicitly handle .command files, for resumed sessions.

visionAuto.description: The model that describes images when Vision names none, and those that can be named.

imageGenAuto.description: The model magpie's generate_image tool draws with when ImageGen names none, and those that can be named.

lanURLs.description: Where other machines reach the gateway while it is shared.

lanContainer.description: LANURLs are a container's own addresses, not the host's.

codexWarmed.description: When the Codex warm-up last started an account's window.

workbuddy.description: Whether a WorkBuddy (China) account is signed in, and each one's last daily check-in.

fx.description: The dollar-to-yuan rate costs are shown at when the currency is cny.

notifyProblem.description: NotifyProblem is why a usage alert set wouldn't be seen.

context.description: The model's context window, when known.

fx.description: The dollar-to-yuan rate costs are shown at when the currency is cny.

unlisted.description: Unlisted are the models kept for routing groups, which the pickers don't offer.

default.description: Its own name, when the user gave it another.

kept.description: The reasoning levels the user keeps of Efforts, when not all.

images.description: Agents are told it can see images.

imageSet.description: The user said so, rather than its vendor.

max.description: The most its context may be set to, above Context.

own.description: Own is the agent's own sign-in, which magpie only reads.

paused.description: Paused is the account the agent is signed in to, passed over by the gateway while another is on.

fetched.description: When the model list last came from the vendor; absent until it has.

searches.description: The vendor searches the web by itself.

proxy.description: The proxy its requests go through.

accountProxies.description: The proxy of each of a subscription's accounts that has one of its own, by its name in lower case.

stepPlan.description: A StepFun provider's Step Plan windows, told only to a platform sign-in.

zhipuTeam.description: A Zhipu or Z.ai key's team, for a team's GLM Coding Plan.

draws.description: How many of its models draw images.

drawIds.description: Those models' ids, listed apart in its editor.

groups.description: Groups are the routing groups ("group/<id>") each of its models is in, by model id.

off.description: Switched off: kept, but agents get none of its models.

move.description: Move is where a built-in subscription stands with the community plugin that can run it.

window.description: The magpie serving it shows its routing.

codexDaemon.description: CodexDaemon is the account Codex's background app-server is still signed in to after Codex was switched to another.

plugins.description: Plugins are the providers the plugins sign in to, for the add sheet.

onPlugins.description: OnPlugins are the built-in subscriptions moved onto their plugins, which the add sheet offers as the plugin's alone.

moved.description: Moved is the agents the change moved off models it stopped serving, for the page to say so.

url.description: The vendor's page to open, empty until there is one.

code.description: What to type there, for a device code.

pasteCallback.description: A callback URL can also finish this sign-in.

pasteCode.description: PasteCode is a plugin's sign-in finished by the code its page shows.

instructions.description: A plugin's words for its page.

installing.description: Installing is the CLI being installed before the sign-in can start.
